title: Expectation of a translated product
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $a,b$ be real-valued functions on the binary cube $\mathbb F_2^n$. If $x$ and $h$ are independent and uniformly distributed on that cube, then $\mathbb E[a(x)b(x+h)]=(\mathbb E a)(\mathbb E b)$.
